title: Soft X-ray Tomography for Quantitative Ultrastructural Mapping of Single Cells
content: The primary goal of contemporary Structural Cell Biology is to understand sub-cellular features, as this reveals the intrinsic characteristics that govern a cell’s behavior and function. These characteristics enable the cell to operate in a coordinated manner within the same tissue or across different organs. A comprehensive understanding of these features is essential for accurately describing a single cell’s function and predicting its behavior in various conditions [1]. Ultimately, mesoscale structural analysis serves as a crucial foundation for linking cell architecture and function to its underlying molecular mechanisms.
